title: IT Helpdesk Ticketing System
summary: A web-based helpdesk where staff report IT issues and the IT team tracks, prioritizes, and resolves them in one place.
builtFor: The IT office of a local school
overview: IT requests used to arrive through chat messages, phone calls, and walk-ins, so issues were easy to lose and hard to follow up. This system gives every request a ticket with a category, priority, and status.

Staff submit tickets through a simple form. The IT team works from a dashboard that shows open, in-progress, and closed tickets at a glance, with charts that reveal which kinds of problems come up most often.
features: Ticket submission with categories (network, printer, computer, LMS, database)
Status workflow: New → In Progress → Closed
Priority levels (low, medium, high) for faster triage
Admin dashboard with ticket status, history, priority, and category charts
Reports and user account management with roles
In-app notifications for new and updated tickets

title: AI Plagiarism & Paraphrasing Checker
summary: Checks uploaded documents or pasted text for similarity and can paraphrase content before checking, returning a clear percentage score.
overview: Checking work for originality by hand is slow. This tool lets a user upload a document or paste text and get a similarity score in seconds.
An optional paraphrasing step rewrites the text before checking, which helps writers improve their wording and see how it changes the result.
features: Upload a document or paste text directly
Similarity score shown as an easy-to-read percentage
Text comparison powered by natural language processing

videos.description: Uploading a document, optional paraphrasing, and reading the similarity score.

title: MiroMail
summary: An email composer connected to Gmail, with a rich-text mode, a visual design mode for branded emails, and scheduled sending.
builtFor: Small businesses and teams that send branded emails
overview: Designing a good-looking email usually means switching between a design tool and an email client. MiroMail puts both in one place.
Users sign in with Gmail, write in a familiar rich-text editor or switch to a visual design mode, and send immediately or schedule the email for later.
features: Gmail integration for inbox, sent mail, drafts, and trash
Visual design mode for branded, designed emails
Scheduled sending with date and time picker
Clean dashboard layout with sidebar navigation

videos.description: Writing in text mode, designing in visual mode, and scheduling the send.
